package.name: h12_deploy_mjpc
package.description: MJPC balance control for the Unitree H1-2: the fork's own CLI cores (badinkajink/mujoco_mpc@extended_hw mjpc/deploy/*.cc + deploy_common.cc, compiled straight from the submodule) run behind rclpy param launchers (rclcpp and unitree_sdk2 CycloneDDS builds must not share a process). Primary chain: the whole-body nu=27 split controller (mjpc_split_core via split_body_controller.py -- legs on the safety layer's split LOWER channel, arms on the UPPER channel with the frame_task pause handshake), plus the fork's RW-EKF proprioceptive base estimator and a debug plan visualizer behind rclpy param shells. The legacy legs-only chain (mjpc_lowerbody_core via controller_launcher.py) is retained.
